wv_forgotten_block_area_the.blurb: A small cluster of boulders tucked into Upper Rock City, the stretch of Coopers Rock State Forest closest to the end of the road near Morgantown. Fifteen of the sixteen climbs here are boulder problems, and the spread is wide: a few easy lines, a solid middle of V2 to V5, and a handful of hard problems up to V8. One trad route in the 5.11 range rounds it out. It is a good stop for a strong boulderer who wants variety on the neighbouring blocks, though the busy trails nearby can mean tourists wandering past.

wv_04_rigor_wall.blurb: Rigor Wall is one of the downstream walls in Bozoo, in southern West Virginia, sitting between Bovine Wall and the Double Tier / Simpson's Wall section. All sixteen climbs are traditional, and a few can also be top-roped. Grades start around 5.6 and run up to 5.11, with the bulk between 5.7 and 5.10, so it suits climbers building their leading skills before moving on to longer, harder lines. The cliffs at Bozoo form a short band and tend to be uncrowded.

wv_7_orchard_wall.blurb: Orchard Wall is the seventh sector of Fern Buttress, the downstream end of Endless Wall in the New River Gorge. It is known as a crack-climbing hub: thirteen of its sixteen routes are trad, with two sport lines and one top-rope. Grades are mostly 5.10 to 5.12, with one 5.8 for a gentler start, so it favors climbers who are comfortable on steady crack and face climbing at the 5.10 level and up. The wall sits between the Thieves Area and the Ritz Cracker Area along the buttress.

wv_bear_rock_lake_bouldering_wheeling.blurb: A small patch of sandstone boulders in quiet woods in the Northern Panhandle, east of Wheeling beside a lake. Around a dozen blocks sit close together, and each has at least one worthwhile line, giving sixteen problems in total. Grades sit mostly in the V2 to V4 range, with a couple of easier problems and a few harder ones up to V6; G-String, a V4, is a favourite. The rock is finer-grained and more tightly packed than at nearby Coopers Rock. Some tops are dirty and cleaning is still going on, so expect a little moss.
